title: 2026 Tavelo Arow + Pertual ACME wheels

takeaways.text: Tavelo told the retailer-presenter it made small lay-up changes, mainly at the front, for this 2026 Arow; he found it far more lively and connected in turns than the earlier Arow he had called fast but numb.

Two lay-ups now exist: standard ('Race') and a lighter 'Ultra'; this Neo Blue paint is offered only on the standard frame. His size small is built with L-Twoo wireless, a CRW bar and Pertual Acme 62 mm wheels.
The finished size-small bike weighed 6.6 kg with computer mount, bottle cages and power-meter pedals.

disclosure: China Cycling's founder also leads Panda Podium, a retailer of Chinese cycling products.
summary: Exact-model build context for the 2026 Tavelo Arow; the wheel package and video pricing do not establish a mainland-China SKU or current RMB price.
